actions.text:
Hi David — thanks for reaching out and for the detailed brief. I’m interested in the compliance dashboard project and appreciate the clear scope.

Before proceeding: I noticed the links in your message point to external sites (including a domain with a digit in the company name and a DocuSign-looking URL). For security I won’t open external links or sign documents from unknown domains. Could you confirm your company’s official domain (e.g., nexgenfinancial.com) and send the NDA via an official DocuSign link (docusign.com) or upload the document directly here on FreelanceHub? That will help me verify everything on my end.

A few quick questions to confirm scope: 
- Do you have existing APIs (or sample responses) for the real-time transaction feed? 
- Are there any specific compliance frameworks or regs you want prioritized (e.g., OFAC, BSA/AML, PCI)? 
- Do you have authentication requirements for data access (OAuth, mTLS, API keys)?

Budget & timing: your $8k fixed price and 6-week timeline are reasonable pending final scope. I’m available to start next Monday but can also be flexible if you need a short onboarding window.

I’m happy to hop on a call to finalize requirements — I’m available Tue–Thu next week 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00 CST. You can also share API docs or example payloads here and I’ll draft a brief proposal and timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to your reply.

— Jordan Mitchell
jordan.mitchell@email.com | +1 (512) 555-0147
